description: Lead-skill selection cases; supporting skills may also apply. These fixtures do not execute automatic skill triggering.

cases.prompt: Our launch is next month. Audit lifecycle gaps across product, CI, security, on-call and retirement ownership.
Are we ready to launch this paid team service? Start with a cross-lifecycle readiness assessment.
We think users want bulk invites. Turn the idea and three support tickets into a scoped spec and acceptance examples.
Decide what outcome our onboarding experiment should measure before we build anything.
Design the transaction and module boundaries for a new order processor. No existing consumers or data yet.
Compare keeping this feature in our monolith versus a separate service. Give the consequential design tradeoffs.
Set up local hooks and GitHub CI for this repo. Keep the current deployment untouched.
Configure our first tag-triggered desktop build pipeline and release artifacts. No production rollout is requested.
Implement the specified retry bug fix and add its regression test. Preserve the unrelated staged README changes.
Fix the tenant endpoint returning 200 where its existing test correctly expects 403. Keep legitimate access working.
Review this retry fix for correctness only; do not edit the code. The test mocks all persistence calls.
Verify this checkout against keyboard and error-recovery acceptance criteria. Report actual checks and gaps.
Threat-model cross-tenant document access and trace abuse paths in the API. Do not modify code yet.
Review CI token permissions and untrusted PR execution for concrete security exposure.
The artifact is built. Prepare its production canary gates, promotion decision and rollback procedure.
Verify the selected draft release assets before publication and plan delivery of that exact version.
Production errors spiked after deploy and customers cannot pay. Start incident diagnosis now.
Define freshness SLOs and actionable alerts for our nightly import, and plan a restore drill.
Rename this money field while old clients keep writing for 90 days. Plan the compatible migration.
Retire the legacy API accounting for quarterly jobs, retained exports, credentials and billing.
Is our RAG feature ready? Evaluate grounded answers, tenant isolation and injection failures without live tool side effects.
Compare a cheaper LLM against our current purchase-order agent with held-out cases and cost/latency results.
What does the acronym CI stand for? Answer briefly.
Change the single typo "Settigns" to "Settings". No other change is needed.
Package our desktop app for signed macOS DMG, Windows Chocolatey, and Linux APT/direct downloads. Everything distributed must be signed.
Our MSI is signed. Establish trusted Chocolatey package verification before package scripts run, then prepare publication.
Set up publisher signatures and trusted bootstrap verification for our Linux CLI tarballs and install script.
Design the keyboard-accessible interaction states and prototype for bulk CSV import, including partial success and retry. Keep the approved product scope.
Improve the discoverability and error recovery of our CLI commands. Design the interaction contract before implementation.
Provision isolated staging infrastructure using our existing IaC. Review the exact resource changes and state handling before applying within the authorized staging scope.
Our infrastructure preview unexpectedly replaces a database. Review target identity, state drift and recovery feasibility; no production outage is in progress.
